rows.en: Ace is resting in the back room.
Ace, brainwave level, normal! Ace, brainwave level, normal!
He's fully conscious, so he'll be fine.
Jack is resting in the back room.
Jack, brainwave level, normal! Jack, brainwave level, normal!
He's fully conscious, so he'll be fine.
Yeah. Now I can finally focus on being a technician.
Hikari... The reason we've been able to keep fighting this far is that you held all of us together.
Spare me the flattery. Besides, this suits me better.
Zoffy is the captain of the Space Garrison, after all. The fact that he agreed to be our commander
means a great deal.
...Really? To think even the Land of Light is frozen solid...
What on earth happened there?
I heard the "Ultra Cube" is frozen.
Hikari and I were just discussing the cause.
Did you find out anything?
...One possibility is that something has gone wrong with the Plasma Spark.
The Plasma Spark...!!
We won't know for sure until we go there and check...
Your body's all right now.
But if you take the same attack again, I can't guarantee you'll make it.
So the cause was the Plasma Spark after all...
And on top of that, the one who stole the Plasma Spark was Belial...!!
I can't forgive him!! Belial's the one I'll never forgive, no matter what!!
Calm down. Getting impatient won't do any good.
But, Dad!!
He's fled. He's not in that Cube anymore.
Right now, finding Taro comes first. He's an irreplaceable comrade, isn't he?
Comrade...
That's right. We Ultra Warriors have always joined forces and overcome every hardship together.
Didn't Taro risk himself to guard the last flame precisely because he believed in his comrades?
...I know that much, okay? I just got a little worked up, that's all.
A fighting tournament? What a strange thing to come up with.
I just know there's something behind it!
Huh? You think so too? Right? Anyone would, right...?
Master Gundam has started something strange...
What's he after?
The ones gathered there are tough opponents, sure, but not ones we can't beat as we are now.
For now, let's play along with the enemy's script.
Agreed.
Jack and Ace, plus Accel and Birth... they're all resting in the medical room.
Don't worry, their lives aren't in danger.
There's not much time left before the finals, right!? This is no time to be goofing off here!
Another Gundam's joined us, huh.
You mean me? I'm God Gundam. Good to meet you.
By the way, do you know anything about the Devil Gundam?
...Sorry, no idea. I've been here the whole time, you see...
I see... Sorry about that. I've gotten into the habit of asking it in place of a greeting.
Our new ally, God Gundam... I hear he's searching for the "Devil Gundam."
I hear it's the source of the DG Cells. I've been looking into it in my own way, but...
When it comes to Gundams, wouldn't you know more about it than I do?
It's a Gundam from a different world. There's a lot I don't understand about it either.
I know, let's compile information on the Gundams too, like the GUYS Archive.
Agreed.
I heard you're almost out of time! Shouldn't you be hurrying!?
How's the final tournament going?
Somehow, I kind of want to go cheer you on.
...I know, I know! I'm kidding. It's not that kind of fun event, right?
...So? The third of the Devil Gundam's Four Heavenly Kings is?
Walter Gundam.
I see. And the last one is Master Gundam, then?
Yeah. No doubt about it. By the way, what are you going to do with this?
We're building a database.
We know the enemy is pushing ahead with its DG Cell research. But we have no experts on our side.
So we plan to compile the scraps of info we've learned so far and share them with everyone.
If that's how it is, you've got it. Ask me anything.
Thanks. But that's enough for today.
Put the final tournament first.
Got it.
Huh? Weren't you supposed to be rescuing Taro?
I figured he'd need regeneration treatment, so I've got everything ready and waiting here.
Hurry up and go!!
So Master Gundam got away...
Yeah...
Did he say anything?
Let's see, I think... he said something like "I've found a fine sample."
What's that supposed to mean? ...God Gundam, any idea?
No idea. But knowing him, it's definitely connected to the Devil Gundam.
I see... Let's keep working to dig up information.
Come to think of it, we've gathered a fair amount of information by now.

Haro, unlabelled. Haro's clipped robot speech kept with the doubled line, as in story_186 ('Haro explain Equipment Upgrade!' x2). 'Seijou' in katakana -> 'normal'. Same for #0.163.
'Ishiki wa shikkari' = fully conscious; 'He' = Ace (g=m). Same for #0.164 (Jack).
Hikari, after Zoffy was welcomed as commander (story_064/183); he no longer has to lead. 'Gijutsuya' = technician/tech guy.
Seravee. Sentence runs on into #0.172; cut at the same point. 'Shireikan' = commander, as in story_064.
Methuss reacting to news of the frozen Ultra Cube (Land of Light). Listener = party leader.
Unlabelled; read as Methuss (medic of the shop) checking on someone after the Belial/Plasma Spark battle; listener not settled by the script, so plain 'you'.
Zero. 'Belial dake wa, zettai ni' = Belial alone he will never forgive; subject/verb restored.
Oyaji -> 'Dad' (glossary, Zero to Seven).
'Saigo no honoo' = the last flame (of the Plasma Spark), as in story_182. 'Mi wo teishite' = putting his own body on the line; 'risk himself to guard'.
Methuss replying to the leader's unheard agreement; 'futsuu, sou yo ne' = anyone would normally think so.
'Abura wo uru' = loafing/goofing off. 'Kesshousen' = the finals.
Methuss. The source has no break between the two sentences; English punctuated normally.
God Gundam: asking about the Devil Gundam has become his greeting habit.
Hikari. 'Oyadama' (boss/ringleader) of the DG Cells -> 'source'. Devil Gundam g=n -> 'it'.
'GUYS Archive' as in story_006/179 ('GUYS Archive Document').
Source has a trailing line break with a space; not reproduced.
'Seigen jikan ga nai' = the (11-hour) time limit is nearly up.
'Kesshou tournament' = final tournament, as in story_070.
Hikari asking God Gundam; Four Heavenly Kings per glossary.
Methuss: the team came back without Taro; 'kyuushutsu shite kita n ja nai no' read as 'weren't you supposed to come back having rescued him'.
'Saisei chiryou' = regeneration treatment (cf. regeneration capsule). 'He' = Taro.
Ankh quoting Master Gundam; 'fine sample' matches story_088 #0.297.
Hikari; the conversation continues into talk_010 (#0.301 Ankh).
